An intensely pruritic infestation caused by human mite Sarcoptes scabiei. It is
contracted by close contact and rarely via fomites. Occurs commonly in
children and inmates of overcrowded institutions such as prisons and boarding
houses. Infection of households is common. Sexual intercourse is also another
possible method of spread among adults. Sharing a bed or using the same
underwear will also suffice to contact the disease.
